trials.claim: Tool enables crafting professional-grade promotional videos in just a few clicks
trials.claimQuote: Easily craft stunning, professional-grade promotional videos in just a few clicks with our user-friendly tool
trials.reasoning: Reviewers say generated videos require further editing and the tool does not feel built for high-end production. This directly limits the claim of professional-grade videos in just a few clicks, outweighing the vendor's own marketing repeat.

exhibits.quote: So far everything I've generated requires further editing.
exhibits.argument: This reports the tool does not deliver finished professional videos in just a few clicks.

exhibits.quote: It doesn’t really feel built for high-end production or ongoing social media management.
exhibits.argument: This directly denies the claim of professional-grade production capability.

exhibits.quote: Create free professional and amazingly looking animated promo videos and stories for Instagram, Facebook, YouTube, and other platforms with Animazer in a few clicks.
exhibits.argument: The vendor itself promises professional animated promo videos in a few clicks.

exhibits.quote: The user-friendly interface made creating engaging videos a breeze, and the professional results exceeded my expectations.
exhibits.argument: The buyer confirms the tool is user-friendly and produces professional results.

themes.summary: Many buyers complain templates are limited, rarely updated, and lack customization like moving text, fonts, and formats.

hits.quote: offering a limited set of templates without regular additions makes it hard to rely on long term.
Noticed the templates are the pretty much the same as they were when I browsed many months back
yes, the templates are limited in terms of variety and customization, BUT this is a very affordable lifetime deal
You can't move blocks, so if you resize text and it overlaps you can't do anything about it.
I can't move the text or add another text and can't change background colour.
Text and images cannot be moved up/down/sideways
Can't Resize Logo, Just Rotate (OFFEO does this with ease)
The current editor is too basic, and Arabic language support is limited.
why are animations not available in all formats?
The only annoyance I've found so far is that some of the vertical + horizontal templates have different levels of customization.
